t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The participant found that picking the right hand gnome yielded higher mushrooms in the 20 practice rounds that they participated in, it's not conclusive but that was what they thought.

vb_textbox.text: I initially based my decisions on the advice given to me by a prior participant. This advice was that gnomes on the right hand side yielded more mushrooms. I tested this through the experiment and found this to be true. Each time i did use the left side gnome, i almost always got zero mushrooms. So my recommendation to you would be to always just pick the gnome on the right to maximise your score in the game.
